text: Normally you blink about fifteen times a minute. You never notice.
Each blink spreads tears over your eye. It keeps it wet and wipes off dust.
Most people last somewhere between ten seconds and half a minute.
Then the sting. Then the blur. Your eyes beg you to blink, and you give in.
The longest unofficial record is an actor on TV: a little over an hour.
A full day is nearly nineteen times that.
